stop_condition: stop if static work-item schema cannot be materialized
stop if adapter would need labels or hidden/oracle metadata in actor input
stop if guardrail requirements cannot be enforced
stop if the next route would execute measured rollout without result audit
fallback_plan: route to result audit if adapter produces valid artifacts
route to concrete overlay design if reset is blocked by missing numeric overlays
route to branch synthesis if adapter reveals broad scenario-quality redesign gaps
stop for user review if claim boundaries are violated
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2457 design routes to adapter implementation

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2458 implements scenario-quality preflight infrastructure and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2458; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M2455/M2457 materialized protocol artifacts and reset/static design.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If reset is blocked by missing concrete overlays, classify it as scenario-spec readiness rather than driver failure.
allowed_claims: no actual success improvement, controller ranking, candidate-family ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit result audit, concrete overlay design, or stop before measured rollout

hypothesis: The M2457 reset/static preflight adapter can materialize M2455 protocol rows into static-valid work items and fail closed on missing concrete overlays without actor-input or claim-boundary violations.
success_criteria: adapter implementation and focused tests exist
summary.json and required CSV artifacts are written
static checks cover every M2455 candidate row
missing concrete overlays are represented explicitly instead of inferred unsafely
no policy action, rollout, scenario-redesign execution, repair, training, ranking, winner, or verdict claim is made
failure_criteria: M2458 executes policy action or measured rollout
M2458 executes scenario redesign, repair, or training
M2458 infers hidden/oracle actor features or changes actor input
M2458 ranks scenario candidates, candidate families, controllers, selected checkpoints, or panel rows as winners
M2458 makes current-sim, paper, FW-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign, or training-repair verdict claims
decision_rule: M2458 passes if it implements and runs the adapter with complete static artifacts, explicit reset readiness or reset-blocked accounting, and no actor-input, policy-action, rollout, repair, training, ranking, winner, or verdict violation.
